data.credibility: Management delivers reliably on short-term numerical targets for revenue and margins, as seen in FY26. However, they are prone to lowering forward revenue growth guidance over subsequent quarters when macroeconomic conditions demand it.

lines.line: Promised 2% to 3% FY26 revenue growth; delivered 3.1% in Q4 FY26.
Promised 20% to 22% operating margin; actual exchange data reached 23.7%.
Targeted 20,000 fresh hires for FY26 and successfully delivered exactly 20,000.
Plans to recruit 20,000 college graduates in the next financial year remain on track.
FY27 revenue guidance started at 1.5% to 3.5% but slipped following multiple quarters of lowered expectations.
Operating margin guidance of 20% to 22% for FY27 remains on track with 23.7% so far.
Expected effective tax rates for FY27 of 29% to 30% remain on track.
Target to reach 6,000 frontier engineers over the next few years remains on track.
Net new mega deal expected to contribute over 1% growth in FY28 is currently pending.

bull: High financial strength with ROE at 31.9%, ROCE at 40.0%, and a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.09.
Strong cash conversion with operating cash flow at 110% of reported profit over the past five years.
Substantial liquidity backed by ₹43,075 crore in consolidated cash and investments.
bear: Revenue growth is decelerating, slowing to 6.8% annually over three years compared to 12.2% over five years.
EBITDA margins have compressed from 27.8% in FY21 down to 23.7% in FY26.
FY27 revenue growth guidance has already faced consecutive downgrades in Q1 and Q2 following its initial announcement.
